newsitem.title: GERMANY: Upbeat outlook for Germany's RWE.
newsitem.headline: Upbeat outlook for Germany's RWE.

text.p: German diversified utility giant RWE AG said Friday it expected a 6.8 percent rise in group net profit in the first nine months of its 1996/97 business year to continue for the full year to the end of June.
In the nine months to March 31, RWE increased its group net profit 6.8 percent to to 878 million marks ($515 million) from the year-earlier period.

"The (earnings) growth will continue. Earnings growth was mostly seen in the energy, engineering and plant construction sectors, while investments in the telecommunications business are clearly higher, as expected," RWE said in a statement.
Group sales rose 7.8 percent to 52.9 billion marks ($31.1 billion).
